title: Auto Parts Supplier for Egypt | Autologic Industries
description: Autologic Industries is an auto parts supplier for Egypt, exporting tuk-tuk, motorcycle and die-cast parts to importers, traders and assemblers.
banner_desc: Tuk-tuk, motorcycle and casting components exported from India for buyers across Egypt.
hero_alt: Clutch assembly from the Autologic range for Egyptian buyers
hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Egypt. We export three-wheeler and motorcycle clutch systems, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium castings.

Tuk-tuks serve neighbourhoods and towns across Egypt, while motorcycles handle deliveries in busy cities such as Cairo and Alexandria. Hot weather and heavy traffic push clutches and brakes hard, so parts need good heat resistance. Browse the range below. Every component is tested in our plant before it is packed for export.

network.title: Why Egyptian Buyers Source From Us
paras: With more than 25 years of manufacturing experience, we test every component before dispatch.
Sourcing clutch, brake and casting parts from one manufacturer reduces supplier management and keeps quality consistent.
We can match parts to the OEM numbers you already stock, helping you add our lines to your catalogue without confusion.

network.title: Shipping Parts to Egypt
paras: Orders travel by sea in palletised export packing to the Egyptian port that suits you, with full documents for your customs broker.
Tuk-tuk, motorcycle and casting items can share one container, and repeat shipments can be scheduled.
Dust-protected packing keeps parts clean during transit and storage.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Egyptian market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to Egypt. Samples can be arranged before your first volume order.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, traders and assemblers in Egypt.
faqs: Do you supply tuk-tuk and motorcycle parts to Egypt?
Yes. Our range covers three-wheeler and two wheeler clutch parts, brake shoes, engine components and aluminium castings.
How do your parts handle heat?
Our friction materials and assemblies are rated for up to 300°C continuous endurance, and aluminium housings help dissipate heat.
Can you make parts to our drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC lines produce components from drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Yes. Samples let you confirm fit before ordering in volume.
Do you supply brake shoes for tuk-tuks?
Yes. Our drum brake shoes have linings engineered to resist fade during heavy city driving.
Can you label parts in our part numbering?
Yes. Cartons can carry your brand and part numbers, which makes stocking and reordering easier for your team.
Can you support local assembly programmes?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC machining lines can supply drawing-based components on a planned delivery schedule.
